title: Roasted Pepper Crunchy Meal
description: A delicious and healthy gluten-free meal made with roasted peppers and a crunchy topping.
instructions: Cut the peppers in half and remove the seeds.
Place the peppers on a baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil.
Roast the peppers in the oven for 30-40 minutes, or until they are tender and slightly charred.
While the peppers are roasting, prepare the gluten-free meal according to package instructions.
Once the peppers are done, top the meal with roasted peppers and a sprinkle of crunchy topping.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
